sources.title: Botswana country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.officialityEvidence: The Polish MFA's live Odyseusz profile is dated 30 June 2026 and directly states the Polish-citizen waiver for stays up to 90 days.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Obywatele Polski pozostający w Botswanie do 90 dni są zwolnieni z obowiązku posiadania wizy.

sources.title: Burkina Faso country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.officialityEvidence: The Polish MFA's live Odyseusz profile is dated 30 June 2026 and directly says Polish citizens who require a visa can apply through Visa Burkina.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Obywatele polscy muszą posiadać wizę, o którą można aplikować online.

sources.title: Visa Burkina electronic visa procedure
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 2026 government visa service identifies the Ministry of Security and National Police and says applicants obtain the visa electronically after online information and payment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les postulants peuvent obtenir leur visa par voie électronique.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.officialityEvidence: The Polish MFA's live Odyseusz profile is dated 30 June 2026 and directs Polish biometric-passport holders who need a visa to the official online process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Obywatele polscy muszą uzyskać wizę. Można o nią aplikować online.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, State-approved Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The State-approved service limits the route to valid ordinary passports and says approved pre-enrolment ends with printing and issuance at Abidjan airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement à l'aéroport d'Abidjan.

sources.title: Mali country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.officialityEvidence: The Polish MFA's live Odyseusz profile is dated 30 June 2026 and directs Polish citizens to apply for the required visa at Mali's Embassy in Berlin.
sources.supportingExcerpt: O wizę można ubiegać się w Ambasadzie Mali w Berlinie.

sources.title: Panama country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.officialityEvidence: The Polish MFA's live Odyseusz profile is dated 30 June 2026 and directly states that no visa is required for stays up to 90 days.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nie ma obowiązku wizowego na pobyt do 90 dni.

sources.title: Tunisia country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.officialityEvidence: The Polish MFA's live Odyseusz profile is dated 2 July 2026 and directly states that no visa is required for stays up to three months.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Wiza nie jest wymagana przy pobytach do 3 miesięcy.

sources.title: Ukraine country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.officialityEvidence: The Polish MFA's live Odyseusz profile is dated 2 July 2026 and directly states visa-free Polish-citizen access for 90 days in 180.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Obywatele polscy mogą wjechać na Ukrainę bez wizy na okres do 90 dni w ciągu 180 dni.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Mali advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Poland's current MFA profile requires Polish visitors to obtain Mali's visa through its Embassy in Berlin.
conditions: Use a biometric passport and apply for the required visitor visa at Mali's Embassy in Berlin.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor access
policies.summary: Current Polish MFA profiles directly establish ordinary Polish-passport visitor waivers for Botswana, Panama, Tunisia and Ukraine.
conditions: Botswana and Panama permit stays up to 90 days; Tunisia permits stays up to three months; Ukraine permits 90 days in any 180-day period.
Passport-validity, security, work, residence, onward-travel, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Poland's current MFA profile directs Polish citizens requiring a visa to the official online route, whose government service confirms electronic visa issuance.
conditions: Use a biometric passport and complete the official electronic application and payment before travel.
The separate travel registration, work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Visa Burkina
steps: Apply using the biometric Polish passport and pay online before travel.
Retain the resulting electronically issued visa for travel.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Poland's current MFA profile directs Polish biometric-passport visitors to SNEDAI, which prints and issues the preapproved visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Use a biometric passport valid for six months from entry; complete online pre-enrolment, payment and document upload, and carry the approved response before boarding.
Complete biometrics at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued; this is border issuance, not an eVisa.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official visa pre-enrolment
steps: Carry the approved response to Abidjan.
Complete biometrics and receive the printed visa at the airport.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback says eVisa, but the official ordinary-passport procedure requires online preapproval and prints and issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
